Introspect the koine backend slot

Source: R/koine_slot.R
koine_status.Rd

Returns the activation state of the koine backend slot plus the procedure to activate it. koine is the synthesised fourth opinion on flexyBayes's orthogonal lens axis (the constellation's C1 + C3 contracts). The slot has been active by default since 2026-06-08 on an installed koine at or above the version floor, gated only by options(quorum.koine_activated); it falls back to dormant (a structured koine_dormant_refusal) when koine is absent, below floor, or the option is set FALSE. This helper is the canonical discoverability surface – call koine_status() to check whether the slot is currently active on the installed koine version and, if not, why and how to activate it.

Usage

koine_status()

Value

A list with components:

activated

Logical: TRUE when koine is installed at or above the activation floor and options(quorum.koine_activated) is not set FALSE (the slot is live as of 2026-06-08).

koine_installed

Logical: result of nzchar(system.file(package = "koine")).

builder_confirmed

Logical: whether koine's koine_pass_from_design builder is installed at or above the floor (the ported emit_koine() confirms it against the koine_pass/koine_result contract).

dormancy_reason

Character: one of "koine_not_installed", "koine_below_floor", "slot_provisioned_not_activated", or "koine_dispatch_eligible" (the last meaning the slot is fully active).

activation_procedure

Character vector: numbered steps to activate the slot, in order.

See also

gretaR_status() (withdrawn from the hub in 0.10.0) for the engine-axis sibling slot.

Examples

ks <- koine_status()
ks$activated         # TRUE when koine (>= 0.2.0) is installed
#> [1] TRUE
ks$dormancy_reason   # "koine_dispatch_eligible" when active
#> [1] "koine_dispatch_eligible"
cat(ks$activation_procedure, sep = "\n")
#> Install the koine package (>= 0.2.0, carrying koine_pass_from_design + the Stage-0 koine_pass/koine_result contract + the poisson (1 | g) corner).
#> Keep options(quorum.koine_activated = TRUE) (the default); set it FALSE to hold the slot dormant.
#> Emit the fourth opinion with emit_koine(fit$fb, data) on a core fit, wrap it and the engine fit with lens_from_fit(), and compare them with agreement_pairwise().
